# CleanzATX — Pure-Water Window Cleaning | Lakeway, Bee Cave & Lake Travis, TX

> Locally owned residential window cleaning and exterior washing company based in Lakeway, Texas, serving the Lake Travis area and West Austin since 2020. Rated 5.0 stars from 210 Google reviews and named a Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite in 2023, 2024 and 2025. Known for pure-water (RO/DI) window cleaning with water-fed poles, published pricing, a 7-day rain guarantee, and quotes sent by text.
